You’ve corrected the denominator mistake from Q1 and explained Q3 and Q4 correctly. That supports **Improving**: you understand this question format, while broader application and retention still need checking. I’ve saved that progress in your [learning record](learning-record.md).

Try this changed condition: Of the **45 shoppers in Q4**, what percentage **both ordered online and returned an item**? Give the percentage and explain your denominator.
